summary: Section B of the 2026 TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks defines coding rules for premiums and losses, including statistical plan, state, loss kind, line of business, policy form, occupancy, construction, roof, protection class, deductible, type of loss, cause of loss, prior claims, ZIP, building-code-credit, law-and-ordinance, optional endorsement, and rating-variable coding. The extraction captures the numbered Section B rules and their associated code lists, plus referenced organizations and endorsement/coverage scope elements. Individual row-level CodeValue nodes were not emitted to avoid excessive duplication; row-level values are preserved within cited rule/code-list spans for downstream deterministic or human extraction if desired.

proposed_nodes.name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks — Section B: Coding for Premiums and Losses
proposed_nodes.title: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks (eff. 2026-01-01), Section B: Coding for Premiums and Losses

proposed_nodes.name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks 2026 Edition
proposed_nodes.edition_name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks 2026

proposed_nodes.name: Statistical Plan Code
proposed_nodes.description: Residential Risk – Dwellings – Homeowners (HO) is coded as 4.

proposed_nodes.name: State Code
proposed_nodes.description: Texas is coded as 42.

proposed_nodes.name: Kind Codes – Losses
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates loss record kind codes for no current payment/outstanding loss, reopened paid losses, paid losses not reopened, and outstanding losses.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 1-9 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Line of Business
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners, dwelling, private flood, supplemental natural disaster protection, and TWIA surcharge lines of business.

proposed_nodes.name: Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners, tenants, condominium, dwelling, ISO, AAIS, and independent policy form codes by line of business scope.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes numeric and alphanumeric form codes shown in the cited table, including ISO HO 00 forms and AAIS forms.

proposed_nodes.name: Number of Families
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates family/occupancy code values for homeowners and dwellings, including dwelling-only, personal-property-only, tenants forms, and dwelling-and-personal-property situations.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 1, 2, 8, and 9 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Coverage – Occupancy
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates coverage and occupancy codes for homeowners and dwelling fire/extended coverage risks, including owner occupied, non-owner occupied, tenant forms, condominium contents, vacant occupancy, liability only, and premium-bearing endorsements.
proposed_nodes.notes: Code 7 for vacant occupancy requires TICO approval before use.

proposed_nodes.name: Construction
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates construction codes and defines construction classifications for frame, stucco, brick veneer, brick, and semi-fire-resistive/fire-resistive classes; mixed construction is coded by predominant exterior wall area.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, and 9 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Roof Covering
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates roof covering material categories and instructs reporting of the category that best fits the predominant roof covering.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes A through P are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Roof Credit
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates roof credit codes for no credit and Class 1 through Class 4 credits; premium credits are reported only for roof coverings meeting UL2218 or other TDI-approved standards.
proposed_nodes.notes: Any policy not eligible for a Class 1, 2, 3, or 4 credit is reported as 0.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.8A — Roof Year Reporting
proposed_nodes.title: Roof Year
proposed_nodes.notes: Sub-rule extracted from the Roof Construction section; report roof installation year in YYYY format, or 0000 if not used in underwriting or rating.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.8B — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.title: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement

proposed_nodes.name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement Indicator
proposed_nodes.description: Binary indicator showing whether the cosmetic damage to roof coverings endorsement is attached to the policy.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement Indicator
proposed_nodes.notes: Code 0 means endorsement is not attached; code 1 means endorsement is attached.

proposed_nodes.name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.form_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes cosmetic damage to roof coverings when attached to the policy.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.9 — Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.title: Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)

proposed_nodes.name: Protection ISO Public Protection Class (PPC)
proposed_nodes.description: Reports the ISO PPC if used in rating; maps PPC 10 to A and PPC 8B to B.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes include 1-9, A, and B.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.9A — Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.title: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications

proposed_nodes.name: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates two-character ISO PPC split classification codes.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Protection ISO Public Protection Class, Including New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes include 01-10 and listed split classes ending in 2/3 combinations through 82/83.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.10 — Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.title: Deductible Type or Amount

proposed_nodes.name: Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates deductible codes for homeowners, tenants/condominium owners, tropical cyclone, dwelling extended coverage/allied lines, personal property, and dwelling records; also provides selection rules when multiple deductibles apply.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes codes 1-9 and A-Z with special seacoast territory and wind exclusion notes.

proposed_nodes.name: Wind Exclusion Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Referenced as the condition for no-wind-coverage deductible code 7 in specified territories.
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes wind coverage in specified territories or catastrophe-area portions where deductible code 7 applies.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.11 — Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.title: Type of Loss Code

proposed_nodes.name: Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners type-of-loss codes for Section I dwelling and personal property, Section II personal liability and medical payments, individual company enhancement endorsements, and other additional premium paying endorsements.
proposed_nodes.notes: Watercraft losses covered under the basic policy meeting specified horsepower/length limits are reported as code 1.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.12 — Cause of Loss Codes
proposed_nodes.title: Cause of Loss Codes

proposed_nodes.name: Cause of Loss
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates homeowners and dwellings cause-of-loss codes and requires reporting the original and proximate cause of loss, not ensuing causes.
proposed_nodes.notes: Includes fire internal/external/unknown source, lightning, windstorm, hail, flood/rising water, explosion, smoke, aircraft/vehicles, riot/civil commotion, vandalism/malicious mischief, collapse, water/steam discharge, freeze, burglary/theft/robbery, other physical damage, and liability/medical payments.

proposed_nodes.name: Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates codes for number of chargeable claims in the last five years and for companies that do not use prior claims history in rating or tiering.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 0 through 6 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.14 — ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.title: ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires the five-digit ZIP code of each risk, and ZIP+4 if available.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.15 — Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.title: Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)

proposed_nodes.name: Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates TWIA-only building code credit codes for seaward, Inland I, and Inland II new structures/retrofitted structures and not applicable.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 01 through 09 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.16 — Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.title: Law and Ordinance Coverage

proposed_nodes.name: Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: Enumerates codes for no additional law and ordinance coverage and for 10%, 15%, 25%, or other approved additional limits purchased.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 0 through 4 are defined in the cited table.

proposed_nodes.name: Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.notes: Coverage type captured because the rule separately codes additional limits for this coverage.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.17 — Optional Credit – Personal Property ID (HO)
proposed_nodes.title: Optional Credit – Personal Property ID (HO)

proposed_nodes.name: Optional Credit – Personal Property ID (HO)
proposed_nodes.description: Binary code indicating whether optional credit for personal property ID applies.
proposed_nodes.notes: Code 0 means the credit does not apply; code 1 means the credit applies.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.18 — Optional Coverage Endorsements
proposed_nodes.title: Optional Coverage Endorsements
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires reporting actual endorsement numbers, excluding dashes, for endorsements providing coverage for mold, water, foundation, or flood, using additional records as needed.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.19 — Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.title: Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: Requires reporting the percent or dollar amount, as applicable, for an optional coverage endorsement.

proposed_nodes.name: Rule B.20 — Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.title: Use of Certain Rating Variables

proposed_nodes.name: Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit codes indicating how specified variables are used in rating or tiering, including alarms, age of home, sprinklers, claims experience, companion policy, credit-based insurance score, senior citizen status, smart/connected home, new/recently purchased home, and additional risk surcharges.
proposed_nodes.notes: Codes 1 through 5 distinguish used/no discount, discount factor, surcharge factor, tier placement, and insurer does not use variable in rating or tiering.
